findings.Finding: Split contract authority; 88/106 mutations use open CommandPayload and generic mutation response.

findings.closureEvidence: docs/api/openapi.json; 41 ready mutations use closed typed request/response schemas; generic production mutation request/result count is zero.
findings.remainingRisk: None for P0; blocked mutations still need module decisions before implementation.

findings.Finding: Production command authority was incomplete and generic routing could diverge from the operation-level OpenAPI contract.

findings.Finding: Support has no API and client owns server fields and transitions.
findings.Impact: Race-prone sequence/SLA/status/audit and mass-assignment exposure.

findings.Finding: Frontend coordinates cross-module transactions with repository snapshots and rollback.
findings.Impact: Browser cannot guarantee atomicity, durable saga state, retries, or compensation.
findings.notes: Reproduced from current source and OpenAPI. P0 closure status recorded after source remediation. P0.2 closes Quote acceptance, standard Order confirmation/cancellation and Payment reconciliation while preserving explicit blockers for credit override, allocation, refund and COD.
